summary.name: MediaGoblin
summary.one_liner: MediaGoblin is a free software media publishing platform that anyone can run, positioned as a decentralized alternative to Flickr, YouTube, and SoundCloud.
use_cases: Hosting a personal photo gallery on your own server
Publishing and sharing video or audio media
Running a community media sharing site
Replacing Flickr, YouTube or SoundCloud with a self-run service
Showing a portfolio of images or media to others
summary.what_it_does: MediaGoblin is a free software media publishing platform that anyone can run on their own server. The page describes it as supporting multiple media types, including video, and built for extensibility. It is part of the GNU project and focused on user freedom. The site links to a feature tour, a guide for installing it on your own server, and a list of existing community instances to join. Development is community-driven, with links to a bug tracker, CI, and source code.
notable: Part of the GNU project, focused on user freedom
Supports multiple media types including video
Decentralized: anyone can run their own instance
Licensed under AGPL-3.0 and written in Python
caveats: Requires installing and running your own server, or joining an existing community instance
Page does not describe a hosted paid service or specific pricing
